nodes.label: apple-touch-icon.png (180x180 iOS Touch Icon — Full Split Circuit-and-Leaf Tree)
nodes.rationale: 180x180px iOS home-screen touch icon rendered cleanly from the upper emblem of image/geo.png over a sky-blue (#74D5F8) to turquoise (#6DDECF) gradient: left hemisphere shows angular green PCB circuit traces ending in circular pads and floating dots (geoprocessing/innovation), right hemisphere shows 14 pointed green organic leaves on curved limbs (agriculture/sustainability), united on a central trunk with flat ground line and no text.

nodes.label: Split Circuit-and-Leaf Tree Brand Mark (Geo + Innovation)
nodes.rationale: Visual brand motif shared across the 5 favicon PNGs and derived from the upper illustration of image/geo.png: left-half angular PCB circuit traces/nodes represent technology and geospatial innovation, while right-half pointed leaves represent nature and agricultural sustainability. Desktop/iOS icons render the full tree in Verde Institucional (#01781E) on Azul Ceu/Turquesa gradient (#74D5F8/#6DDECF); Android/PWA icons crop the upper crown on a white/transparent canvas. None of the favicons contain the Banco do Brasil Z-monogram from image/logo_bb.png.
